victim: हे भगवान! बेटा ये क्या कह रहे हो? मैं तो बुजुर्ग औरत हूँ, घर से बाहर भी नहीं निकलती। मैंने कोई पार्सल नहीं भेजा।

caller: बिल्कुल नहीं! ये सीक्रेट लीगल मैटर है। अगर किसी को भी बताया या कॉल काटा, तो आपके बेटे को भी हम सह-आरोपी बना कर उठा लेंगे। आप अभी डिजिटल कस्टडी में हैं!
victim: नहीं नहीं बेटा, मेरे बच्चे को मत घसीटना प्लीज! मैं किसी को नहीं बता रही, बस बताओ मुझे क्या करना होगा?

caller: Sir aapke account ka KYC pending update dikha raha hai, agar aaj raat barah baje tak update nahi kiya toh aapka account permanently block ho jayega.
caller: Sir RBI ke naye guidelines aaye hain, RBI verification mandatory hai sabhi active accounts ke liye. Aapko abhi turant process complete karna padega.
caller: Nahi sir, branch visit karne se kuch nahi hoga, ye online urgent server update hai jo abhi isi waqt karna hoga nahi toh saare transactions hold par chale jayenge.
caller: Aapke registered mobile number par ek quick verification SMS bheja hai, bas wahi 6 digit ka OTP mujhe turant bataiye.
caller: Haan sir, hold karke rakhiye line par, main system me enter kar raha hoon. Ek aur message aayega abhi.
caller: Ye fund transfer verification code hai system ka, security check ke liye. Jaldi se boliye warna error aa jayega aur account freeze ho jayega.
caller: Sir wo bas temporary system hold amount hai jo verification ke baad turant aapke account mein refund ho jayega, aapko ghabrane ki zaroorat nahi hai.
caller: Agar aapne phone kaata ya kisi aur se baat ki, toh apka account turant block ho jayega aur police case bhi ho sakta hai illegal activity ke liye.
caller: Aapka PAN card fraud transactions me use hua hai, isliye agar bachna hai toh turant OTP share kijiye aur bataya gaya amount transfer kijiye safe account me.
caller: Hello sir, suniye toh, agar aapne phone disconnect kiya toh court warrant nikal jayega aapke ghar ke pata par, line mat kaatiye!
caller: Sir last warning de raha hoon, OTP do nahi toh jail jane se koi nahi ro sakega aaj.

victim: Haan beta pranam. Boliye, kis baare mein call kiya hai?
caller: Sir hum log Kanpur aur Lucknow ke retired railway and government officers ke liye exclusive wealth care support dete hain. Bas aapka hal-chal janne ke liye call kiya tha.
victim: Acha beta. Bas chal raha hai kisi tarah, pension aati hai aur baki savings bank mein rakhi hain.
caller: Sahi baat hai sir. Par aajkal banks mein interest rate kitna gir gaya hai, mushkil se 6 ya 7 percent FD pe milta hai. Mehngai itni badh rahi hai.
victim: Arrey bilkul sach keh rahe ho beta, dawayi aur bijli ke bill mein hi sab nikal jata hai.
caller: Isi problem ke liye sir government ne clean energy projects ke pre-IPO institutional funds mein senior citizens ke liye special fixed return quota release kiya hai.
victim: Yeh share bazaar jaisa hota hai kya? Mujhe toh share bazaar ka koi tajurba nahi hai beta.
caller: Nahi nahi sir, share bazaar mein risk hota hai. Yeh bilkul zero risk scheme hai. Isme government backed security hai aur 24% annual fixed return guaranteed rehta hai.
victim: 24 percent? Itna toh koi bank nahi deta beta. Yeh sach mein safe hai na?
caller: 100 percent safe hai sir, SEBI guidelines ke antargat capital guarantee certificate milta hai. Har mahine ki 5 tareekh ko profit direct aapke bank account mein credit ho jata hai.
victim: Yeh toh bohot accha hai. Par iska form bharne mujhe office aana padega kya Kanpur se Lucknow?
caller: Kahin aane ki zaroorat nahi sir, aap senior citizen hain, hum sab ghar baithe digital portal se setup karwa dete hain. Maine aapke WhatsApp pe ek secure portal link bheja hai.
victim: Ruko ek minute, chashma pehan ke dekhta hoon... haan ek message aaya hai blue link wala.
caller: Ji sir, us link pe tap kijiye aur bas apna naam aur mobile daal dijiye. Main call par hi hoon, help kar raha hoon aapki.
victim: Haan beta, khul gaya. Isme toh green color ka dashboard dikh raha hai.
caller: Bilkul. Wahan demo calculator dekhiye sir. Agar aap 50,000 lagayenge toh har month lagbhag 1,000 rupaye profit lifetime aayega jab tak corpus hold karenge.

caller: Aunty ji hum senior citizen pension holders ke liye welfare financial planning karte hain. Aapka State Bank pension account hai na Indira Nagar branch mein?
caller: Nahi nahi aunty koi dikkat nahi hai, sab bilkul badhiya hai. Bas ek bohot sundar yojana aayi hai visheshkar mataon aur senior women ke liye.
caller: Aunty aapko kuch nahi karna. Hamari trust sovereign digital gold arbitrage chalati hai. Sona toh aap janti hi hain kitna pavitra aur surakshit hota hai.
caller: Bilkul sahi kaha aapne! Toh hamari trust mein aap digital gold pool mein hissa leti hain, jisme har mahine fix 5% fixed munafa aapke khate mein transfer hota hai, guaranteed.
caller: Aunty ji yeh international bullion trading hai, jo badhe business wale karte hain. Abhi government regulations ke tehat senior citizens ko bhi direct participate karne ki permission mil gayi hai.
caller: Aap hamari maa jaisi hain aunty, hum kabhi aapko galat rasta dikhayenge kya? Principal 100 percent insured rehta hai. Ek rupaye ka bhi risk nahi hai.
caller: Paper ki zaroorat nahi aunty. Maine abhi aapke phone par ek official link SMS kiya hai, Bharat Bullion App ka. Aap SMS open kijiye.
caller: Ji aunty, uspe click kijiye, ek chhota sa form aayega. Main line par hi rehta hoon, aapki madad kar deta hoon.
caller: Shabash aunty. Ab wahan dekhiye Golden Senior Citizen Card dikh raha hoga green tick ke sath. Wahan daily profit live calculate hota hai.
caller: Aunty Amit beta wahan bohot busy rehta hai corporate job mein. Aur young bache sochte hain ki parents ko in baaton ki samajh nahi hai. Wo seedhe mana kar denge bina samjhe.
caller: Wahi toh aunty! Jab aap agle mahine apne munafey ke paise se uske liye Mithai aur gifts bhejengi na Lucknow se, tab wo kitna khush hoga. Pehle aap start kar lijiye, fir surprise dijiyega.
caller: Aunty aap sirf 30,000 se test shuru kar sakti hain. Aur yeh slot sirf aaj dopahar 3 baje tak hi valid hai, kyunki bullion market trading session band ho jata hai.
caller: Aapke app screen pe dekhiye UPI payment option aa raha hoga 'Clearing Trust Account'. Uspe tap karke phonepe ya Paytm se turant 30,000 transfer kar dijiye.
caller: Aunty Manoj Traders hamara authorized settlement liquidity partner hai Reserve Bank bullion norms ke mutabiq. Koi chinta mat kijiye, call disconnect mat kariyega.
caller: Aunty mujh par bharosa rakhiye, agar 10 minute mein slot expire ho gaya toh yeh mouka 6 mahine tak nahi aayega. Main line par hoon, turant UPI PIN daal ke proceed dabaiye.

victim: Yes, Alok here. I am in the middle of a client meeting right now. Who is this?
caller: Sir, sorry to disturb you, main HDFC Bank head office verification team se baat kar raha hoon. Actually ek routine update ke regarding call tha.
victim: Routine update? Mera account toh perfectly fine hai. Can you make it quick?
caller: Sir, bas ek minute. RBI guidelines ke according aapke salary account ka mandatory periodic re-KYC pending dikha raha hai system mein.
victim: Arrey yaar, maine pichle saal hi toh netbanking se update kiya tha. Phir se kyu chahiye?
caller: Sir, wo periodic review hota hai. Last month aapka PAN validation flag hua tha, par shayad message miss ho gaya hoga aapka.
victim: Acha. Chalo main kal Hazratganj branch jaake physical documents submit kar dunga.
caller: Sir branch visit bilkul kar sakte hain, but system mein today's cutoff time 4 PM show kar raha hai. Aaj last date hai sir.
victim: Wait, 4 PM? Abhi 3:15 baj rahe hain! Aise achanak kaise band kar doge bina prior notice ke?
caller: Notice system automatically send karta hai sir via email and SMS. Aaj 4 baje system debit freeze kar dega agar KYC acknowledge nahi hua.
victim: Damn it, meri client ko payments release karni hain sham ko. Debit freeze hua toh heavy penalty lag jayegi mujhe.
caller: Wahi sir, hum corporate clients ko help karne ke liye hi direct call karte hain. Aapko branch aane ki bilkul jarurat nahi padegi.
victim: Online ho jayega kya abhi turant? Mere paas time bilkul nahi hai, please jaldi batao process.
caller: Ji sir, 2 minute lagta hai bas. Server pe e-KYC sync karna hoga live call par hi.
victim: Theek hai, bolo kya karna hai. Main desktop ke samne hi baitha hoon.
caller: Sir desktop ki jarurat nahi hai. Aapke registered mobile par bank terminal se ek fast-track authentication push kiya hai.
victim: Ek SMS aaya hai... 'HDFC Bank secure link for instant re-validation'. Yahi hai?
caller: Yes sir, wahi official link hai. Uspar tap karke banking portal open kijiye, taaki account hold pe na jaye.
victim: Wait, yeh link thoda ajeeb lag raha hai... hdfc-portal-kyc-update.in? Ye genuine hai na?
caller: Sir wo cloud server ka internal routing address hai corporate fast-track verification ke liye. Aap tension mat lijiye, safe server hai.
victim: Hmm, page open hua hai. Customer ID aur mobile number maang raha hai. Bhar diya maine.
caller: Theek hai sir. Ab screen par ek validation pop-up aayega aur ek 6-digit security passkey SMS pe trigger hogi.
victim: Haan, phone vibrate hua... message aaya hai.
caller: Sir system token active karne ke liye wo 6-digit code bata dijiye, main server par authorize kar deta hoon abhi.
victim: Lekin message mein likha hai 'Do not share OTP with bank staff for transaction of INR 85,000'. Ye kya bakwaas hai?
caller: Sir wo dummy debit test hota hai automated server se check karne ke liye. Account se single rupee nahi katega, bas token sync ke liye OTP batayein jaldi.
